client.need_create: Or create one under "FoxOS VM on this PC" below: pick a FoxOS preset and the virtualization this PC has, and the app downloads, creates and starts it.
client.need_iso: No FoxOS yet? Download the latest FoxOS OS preview ISO ({0} or newer), then create a VM in Hyper-V, VirtualBox or QEMU and install it (see the install guide).
client.need_remote: Already have FoxOS on another computer or server? Connect with "Remote FoxOS (SSH)", or run foxos machine serve on it and use "Pair a new FoxOS". Until a {0} ISO is out, you can also use any Linux desktop (X11 session) with foxos {0}+, OpenSSH and x11vnc installed as the guest; see the Windows client guide.
client.need_ssh: In FoxOS, turn on SSH and add this PC's public key. On this PC, run ssh-keygen -t ed25519 in PowerShell. Then, in a FoxOS terminal, run foxos ssh enable and foxos ssh keys add --key "<contents of id_ed25519.pub>" (or --github <your user name>). Finally, enter the address and private key under "Remote FoxOS (SSH)" below.
client.need_version: This app doesn't run anything itself. It connects to a FoxOS computer (a VM or another machine) and hands every action to it. It needs FoxOS {0} or newer, because SSH (key-only), agents (foxos acp) and chat start with {0}. ISOs 0.3.2 and older have no SSH, so the app can't connect to them.

ev.desc.accounting: Double-entry bookkeeping on Puter: invoices, bills, banking, reconciliation, and financial reports
ev.desc.api-client: API Client: build, send, test and organize HTTP requests in your browser, with optional sync to your Puter cloud.
ev.desc.assets: Asset and Equipment Manager: track laptops, tools, warranties, assignments, maintenance, and return dates.
ev.desc.audio-studio: Audio Studio: a waveform and multitrack audio editor on Puter. Record, edit, restore, mix and master audio in the browser, stored in your own cloud.
ev.desc.backgammon: Play backgammon against the computer or a friend — locally or online. No frameworks, just the web.
ev.desc.building-design: Building Design: building information modeling in the browser. Model walls, doors, windows, floors, roofs, stairs and rooms on levels, then work in plans, elevations, sections, 3D, schedules and sheets.
ev.desc.cad: 2D drafting and design: precise drawing, editing, layers, blocks, annotation, and DWG and DXF exchange in the browser.
ev.desc.calendar: A modern, minimal calendar app for the web, powered by Puter.js.
ev.desc.cap-table: Cap table management on Puter — ownership, equity, options, and fundraising in one place
ev.desc.checkers: Play checkers against the computer or a friend — locally or online. No frameworks, just the web.
ev.desc.chess: Play chess against the computer or a friend — locally or online. No frameworks, just the web.
ev.desc.childcare: Childcare center management: check-in, daily activity reports, family messaging, and tuition billing.
ev.desc.circuits: Circuits: schematic capture and PCB layout in the browser. Draw schematics, lay out boards with WebGL rendering, pour copper, check design rules and export Gerber files, stored in your own Puter cloud.
ev.desc.contacts: A clean, fast, private address book that lives in your Puter cloud.
ev.desc.contracts: Contract Manager — store agreements, track renewal dates, extract obligations, and connect documents to contacts. Built on Puter.
ev.desc.crm: CRM & Sales Pipeline — leads, companies, deals, follow-ups, and forecasts on Puter
ev.desc.documents: Documents: a fast, private word processor on Puter. Real .docx files in your own cloud.
ev.desc.email: A fast, private email client for your Puter account
ev.desc.expense: Expenses: receipt capture with AI OCR, expense reports, and reconciliation, on Puter
ev.desc.field-service: Field service management: clients, requests, quotes, jobs, scheduling, invoices, and payments.
ev.desc.fleet: Fleet management: vehicles, inspections, issues, service, work orders, reminders, fuel, parts, and costs.
ev.desc.help-desk: Help Desk: shared inbox, tickets, customers, help center and reports, stored in your own Puter cloud.
ev.desc.hiring: Hiring & applicant tracking: job pages, candidate pipeline, interview scheduling, scorecards, offers, and onboarding.
ev.desc.inventory: Inventory management on Puter: products, quantities, locations, purchase cost, low-stock alerts, suppliers, and CSV import/export
ev.desc.invoicing: Invoicing and estimates on Puter: quotes, invoices, recurring billing, receipts, and payment links
ev.desc.legal: Legal practice management: matters, contacts, time and expense tracking, billing, trust accounting, calendar, tasks, and documents.
ev.desc.meetings: Puter Meetings — realtime video meetings built entirely on Puter.js and the Puter Peer API.
ev.desc.music-studio: Music Studio: a pattern-based music production workstation on Puter. Program beats in the channel rack, write melodies in the piano roll, arrange in the playlist and mix with studio effects, in your browser.
ev.desc.notes: Notes: a free-form digital notebook on Puter. Notebooks, sections, pages, tags, ink and search, stored in your own cloud.
ev.desc.parametric: Parametric: feature-based 3D part modeling in the browser. Sketch with constraints, extrude, revolve, fillet, shell and pattern on a real B-rep kernel, then export STEP and STL, stored in your own Puter cloud.
ev.desc.pdf: A private, framework-free PDF workspace powered by Puter.
ev.desc.photo-studio: Photo editing: layers, adjustments, filters and AI edits
ev.desc.pos: Point of Sale — catalog, checkout, receipts, discounts, taxes, and sales reports on Puter
ev.desc.presentation: A clean, accessible presentation editor with real PPTX files and Puter cloud storage.
ev.desc.projects: Lightweight project management — kanban boards, timelines, milestones, comments, and attachments on Puter
ev.desc.property-management: Property management: properties, units, leases, tenants, rent collection, accounting, maintenance, and reports.
ev.desc.records: Records: connected tables, views and forms for your data, stored in your own Puter cloud.
ev.desc.shifts: Shift scheduling: employee availability, shift assignments, swaps, and attendance.
ev.desc.signatures: Send documents for signature and manage them, powered by Puter
ev.desc.spreadsheet: A fast, private spreadsheet app on Puter: formulas, formatting, and .xlsx files in your own cloud
ev.desc.sudoku: A clean, fast Sudoku you can play in any browser. Four difficulties, a daily puzzle, pencil marks, and hints that explain the logic.
ev.desc.survey: Surveys: build questionnaires, share them with a link, and analyze the results, stored in your own Puter cloud.
ev.desc.tasks: Tasks — personal and shared to-do lists on Puter
ev.desc.teamchat: Team messaging on Puter: workspaces, channels, threads, and direct messages
ev.desc.time-tracking: Timesheets and time tracking. Track billable hours by client, project, or task, on Puter.
ev.desc.vector-studio: Vector Studio: a professional vector illustration editor on Puter. Pen, shape, brush and liquify tools, live effects, symbols, envelopes, 3D, type, artboards, collaboration, SVG and PDF export, stored in your own cloud.
ev.desc.video-studio: Video Studio: a multi-track video editor on Puter. Timeline editing, text, effects, transitions, filters, keyframes, captions and export, stored in your own cloud.
ev.desc.whiteboard: Infinite-canvas whiteboard: drawing, shapes, sticky notes and connectors
ev.desc.wiki: Wiki: pages, docs and databases for you and your team, stored in your own Puter cloud.
ev.issue.assets: The src/assets folder at upstream commit 0fbb88cd only has index.html/package.json/vite.config.js and lacks the /src/main.js that index.html references (the GitHub contents API returns 404 for src/assets/src), so it cannot be built.
